messages.subject: Cees | Industrial & Energy Executive | ESG, Government Relations and International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Cees,

Your leadership of Kestria's Industrial / Production practice across EMEA, together with your Energy, Natural Resources & Infrastructure coverage, makes this a focused introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications within a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage and carbon-data readiness, giving me direct exposure to responsible industrial transition.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership in industrial, mining, energy and infrastructure businesses. I am internationally mobile and open to Europe, the Middle East and other global assignments.

I have attached a Kestria-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for current or future searches where this background aligns.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
